summary: Transform Swarm Coder's delivery model from flat, individual file symlinks into native, self-contained plugin bundles for Google Antigravity, Anthropic Claude Code, and OpenAI Codex. Package agents, skills, rules, and mechanical hooks into harness-compliant plugin structures while retaining this repository as the single source of truth, enabling cleaner encapsulation, namespacing, and project/global plugin installation.

architecture.changeSummary: Migrate from individual flat agent/skill symlinks across ~/.claude, ~/.gemini, and ~/.codex to structured plugin bundles (plugins/agy, plugins/claude, plugins/codex) with native manifests, unified lifecycle hook integration, and project/global installation support.

components.name: Plugin Manifests & Structure
components.purpose: Defines native plugin manifests (plugin.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .codex-plugin/plugin.json) and bundles agents, skills, and rules into harness-compliant directory trees.

components.name: Harness Plugin Installer
components.purpose: Manages idempotent installation, updates, and uninstallation of plugin bundles into Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex configuration directories with foreign-asset refusal.

components.name: Mechanical Hook Integration
components.purpose: Integrates tdd-guard and build-hooks directly into plugin lifecycle configurations across all supported harnesses.

components.name: Project Bootstrap & Verification
components.purpose: Enables workspace-level plugin deployment into target repositories and tests installation parity across all three environments.

issues.title: Define cross-harness plugin structures and manifest specifications
issues.body: Establish unified, harness-compliant plugin directory layouts for Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex. Create plugins/agy/swarm-coder/plugin.json (mapping agents, skills, hooks, and rules), plugins/claude/swarm-coder/.claude-plugin/plugin.json (mapping skills, subagents, commands, and hooks), and plugins/codex/swarm-coder/.codex-plugin/plugin.json (mapping skills and tools). Ensure all skills and agent definitions project cleanly from the centralized skills/ and agents/ directories into their respective plugin structures without duplicate source code.

acceptanceTests.name: manifest-schema-validity
acceptanceTests.oracle: All plugin manifests (plugin.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .codex-plugin/plugin.json) parse as valid JSON and satisfy harness-specific schema requirements.

acceptanceTests.name: plugin-structure-integrity
acceptanceTests.oracle: Each harness plugin directory correctly references all repository skills, agents, and hook definitions without broken symlinks or missing files.

issues.title: Upgrade harness installer to deploy and manage plugins
issues.body: Update scripts/install-harness.sh to support deploying Swarm Coder as native plugins into ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/plugins/swarm-coder, ~/.claude/plugins/swarm-coder, and ~/.codex/plugins/swarm-coder. Support targeting individual harnesses via --harness <agy|claude|codex>, retain strict ownership checks, refuse foreign unowned directories, and provide idempotent --uninstall that removes created plugin symlinks and registrations cleanly.

acceptanceTests.name: install-all-plugins
acceptanceTests.oracle: Running install-harness.sh --install in a fresh test environment creates valid plugin directory symlinks and manifests across Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex.

acceptanceTests.name: uninstall-cleans-plugins
acceptanceTests.oracle: Running install-harness.sh --uninstall completely removes all installed plugin links without leaving orphaned files or touching foreign assets.

acceptanceTests.name: refuses-foreign-plugin
acceptanceTests.oracle: Installation refuses to overwrite an existing foreign directory at the target plugin location and exits non-zero.

issues.title: Integrate mechanical gates and hook configurations into plugins
issues.body: Wire tdd-guard, build-hooks, build-format, and build-lint into the plugin lifecycle manifests. Ensure Antigravity's hooks.json registers pre/post tool hooks within the plugin bundle, Claude Code's plugin hooks wire directly to the verification binaries, and Codex configurations reference the guard tools. Ensure that execution inside plugin environments triggers mechanical gates identically to standalone setups.

acceptanceTests.name: plugin-hooks-validity
acceptanceTests.oracle: Plugin hook configurations correctly map lifecycle events to guard binaries without path resolution errors.

acceptanceTests.name: tdd-guard-executes-via-plugin
acceptanceTests.oracle: Invoking tool operations through a plugin-configured harness triggers build-hooks and enforces TDD seal verification.

issues.title: Update project bootstrap, verification tests, and documentation
issues.body: Update scripts/project-bootstrap.sh to support workspace-scoped plugin installation (.agents/plugins/swarm-coder and .claude/plugins/swarm-coder). Expand the test suite in scripts/tests/test_install.sh to comprehensively test plugin installations across all harnesses. Update README.md and documentation in docs/ to describe plugin architecture, installation steps, and cross-harness namespaces.

acceptanceTests.name: project-bootstrap-installs-local-plugins
acceptanceTests.oracle: Running project-bootstrap.sh in a target workspace sets up local plugin links and excludes them from git tracking.

acceptanceTests.name: test-install-suite-passes
acceptanceTests.oracle: The complete install test suite in scripts/tests/test_install.sh passes 100% with all plugin test cases.

acceptanceTests.name: readme-documents-plugin-architecture
acceptanceTests.oracle: README.md documents the plugin layout, installation commands for all three harnesses, and migration notes.

risks.title: Harness plugin path or manifest format drift across CLI versions
risks.mitigation: Target standard canonical plugin manifest paths and maintain fallback symlinking options in install-harness.sh.

risks.title: Migration conflict with existing flat symlinks in user configuration directories
risks.mitigation: Detect existing flat symlinks during install, report them cleanly, and provide seamless migration/cleanup in --uninstall.

risks.title: Hook execution path differences inside containerized or sandboxed plugin environments
risks.mitigation: Use absolute paths or standardized ~/.local/bin resolution for all hook binary invocations.
